title: What is the Web? Internet, browsers and websites
learningObjectives: Distinguish the internet from the web
Identify browser, website and web application roles

understand.concept: The internet connects networks and devices worldwide. The web is one service that uses the internet to provide linked pages, images and applications.
understand.whyItMatters: This distinction makes URLs, servers, HTML and HTTP easier to understand.
understand.history: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the web at CERN in 1989. The internet's networking foundations developed earlier.
understand.analogy: Think of the internet as a transport network and the web as one service that uses it.
understand.analogyLimit: The internet is not one road system; browsers also interpret documents, apply styles and run scripts.

explain.narrative: A browser is software on your device. A website is a collection of related pages and resources served to visitors. A web application lets people perform tasks or interact with data.

examples.code: Web address → Browser request → Server response → Browser displays the page
examples.explanation: This is simplified. Real visits can also involve DNS, secure connections and caches.
examples.expectedOutput: The page appears in the browser.

practise.guidedTask: Classify a browser, a collection of library pages, and an online book-reservation form. Explain why.
practise.independentTask: Define internet, web, browser and web application in your own words, then describe the page-loading sequence.
hints: The internet connects networks and devices.
A web application supports user tasks.

questions.prompt: How are the web and internet related?
options: The web is one service that uses the internet
The internet is a browser feature
questions.answer: The web is one service that uses the internet
questions.explanation: The internet connects networks; the web uses it to provide linked resources.
